notes: Portable merge patch extracted from the developer-supported Heroes V (3.1) manual hero roster pages 11-69. It fills only supported HeroHOMM5 scalar starts, starting-spell FKs, and HeroSkill rows. It does not edit the cumulative catalog or infer class defaults. Coverage: 106 unique manual hero names, 18 current H5 identities not represented in these pages, 412 scalar fills, 44 starting-spell fills, and 207 HeroSkill additions. Same-name conflicts are preserved in sources.md.
